text: {"features":[{"name":"Role motivation","description":"Assesses how clearly and convincingly the letter explains why this applicant wants this specific role and team.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives only generic interest in the company or job title, with little personal reason or connection to this role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a plausible reason for applying, but the motivation remains broad, formulaic, or easily reusable for many software roles."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains why the role appeals using some connection to the applicant's background, values, or career direction."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a clear and convincing personal rationale for this specific role or team, tied to prior experience or a well-articulated professional aim."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a memorable and authentic motivation that makes the letter feel purpose-built for this role and difficult to repurpose elsewhere."}]},{"name":"Platform enablement mindset","description":"Assesses whether the letter understands the job as building shared security systems that reduce toil and help other engineers work securely at scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the position mainly as a generic software job and shows little understanding of security enablement or organizational leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Acknowledges security impact or large scale in broad terms, but does not explain how the team creates leverage for others."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a basic understanding that the role is about automating security work or embedding security into the development lifecycle."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates a strong platform mindset by emphasizing secure defaults, reduced manual workload, or shared tooling that helps many teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a sophisticated understanding of security engineering as leverage by framing the work in terms of scaling scarce expertise through infrastructure, automation, and developer-friendly systems."}]},{"name":"Software experience depth","description":"Assesses the strength of the applicant's production software background across testing, maintenance, launches, and operational ownership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes only limited production exposure and gives little sense of lifecycle responsibility or sustained ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States the required experience and some production scope, but responsibility, scale, or ownership remains thinly described."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid multi-year experience across testing, maintenance, and launches of several production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production depth with repeated launches, clear operational responsibility, or visible progression into broader ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents extensive production experience with sustained responsibility for multiple services and a credible case for immediate contribution in this role."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"Assesses how strongly the letter demonstrates role-relevant experience building production systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"References Go only at the credential level without any concrete example of what was built in it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Says Go is a main language and mentions some production use, but provides little detail about systems, ownership, or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular professional Go use across multiple services or infrastructure tasks."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects Go directly to backend systems, guardrails, or service ownership that are relevant to security tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to designing or operating the kinds of backend systems this role calls for, with clear architectural responsibility."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"Assesses how convincingly the letter shows production Python experience relevant to automation, analysis, and AI agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python, or mentions it only in passing without any concrete use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims Python familiarity but offers little evidence beyond generic scripting or unspecified tooling."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for automation, analysis, internal services, or similar day-to-day engineering work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python work with clear ownership of services or tooling that other engineers rely on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates deep Python use in role-relevant automation or agent systems, emphasizing production quality, extensibility, or critical operational dependence."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"Assesses how well the letter demonstrates strong data structures and algorithms capability through concrete technical examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of data structure or algorithm strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strong fundamentals but provides no concrete example of applying them."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one concrete example of using algorithms or data structures to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects algorithmic skill to a meaningful redesign or performance improvement in a technically grounded way."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses especially specific and credible algorithmic examples that materially changed system tractability, throughput, complexity, or reliability."}]},{"name":"Applied AI experience","description":"Assesses the depth and realism of the applicant's experience shipping AI or model-backed functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI or language models only vaguely, with no indication of production use or reliability concerns."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes direct work with model-backed features or AI functionality in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows practical experience shipping AI systems while addressing evaluation, safeguards, correctness, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial applied AI experience that is explicitly tied to trustworthy deployment in consequential workflows."}]},{"name":"Agentic tooling design","description":"Assesses experience designing autonomous or semi-autonomous agents and the surrounding control architecture.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any agentic or autonomous tooling experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or pipelines in generic terms without describing architectural choices."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic systems or pipelines with a basic sense of how work is divided."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a clear agent architecture, such as Python agents paired with service-side boundaries or oversight, in a way that feels directly relevant to the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of agentic tooling with explicit permissions, auditing, guardrails, or autonomy design that strongly matches the job."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Assesses experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, deduplication, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any experience with vulnerability handling or triage automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions vulnerability work only generally, without concrete automation details or outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes automating some part of vulnerability intake, routing, or queue handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of vulnerability-triage automation with concrete functions such as classification, deduplication, or routing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability automation as a major accomplishment, explaining how tooling transformed a manual process or returned substantial expert time to the team."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"Assesses hands-on experience evaluating systems for security risks and following findings through remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any security assessment experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security reviews or assessments only in broad terms without clear method, scope, or follow-through."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes performing assessments such as threat models, design reviews, code reviews, or fix validation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantive assessment practice across design or release cycles with visible method and remediation follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates especially credible assessment depth by framing reviews with attacker or builder reasoning, broad scope, and verification that fixes actually held."}]},{"name":"Security commitment","description":"Assesses evidence of sustained security interest outside ordinary software duties through practice, credentials, or competition.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no security engagement beyond ordinary software work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions light extra security interest, such as occasional competitions or a basic certification, without clear depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows recurring security investment through regular competitions, a recognized certification, or consistent attacker-minded practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong extra-role security commitment through serious competition results, a high-signal certification, or multiple reinforcing activities."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys exceptional security commitment through elite offensive practice or demanding hands-on credentials backed by sustained engagement."}]},{"name":"Independent technical initiative","description":"Assesses self-directed engineering work outside assigned responsibilities, such as open-source maintenance, upstream patching, or serious side projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of self-directed technical work outside core job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal app or occasional upstream fix with limited scope or technical ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows steady initiative through a maintained side project, recurring upstream patches, or a modest open-source tool."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial initiative through active open-source maintenance, meaningful release ownership, or an ambitious systems side project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents especially strong self-directed engineering through a public project with real external users or a technically demanding system pursued for its hard design problems."}]},{"name":"Evidence of impact","description":"Assesses how consistently the letter backs its claims with concrete examples, mechanisms, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on assertions of skill or fit, with little concrete evidence, detail, or observable outcome."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few concrete facts such as years or service counts, but most capability claims remain largely unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with specific examples, though scope, mechanism, or outcome is only partly clear."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frequently grounds claims in concrete projects, technical choices, or results that make the application feel credible."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently pairs role-relevant claims with specific examples and observable outcomes, making the letter highly evidence-based."}]},{"name":"Narrative cohesion","description":"Assesses whether the letter forms a coherent story that connects background, evidence, and interest in the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as scattered or list-like, with little logical connection between claims and the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure, but transitions are weak and the case for fit feels assembled rather than argued."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a clear sequence of background, relevant experience, and interest in the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a coherent narrative that links past work, current strengths, and reasons for applying."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a particularly unified and persuasive story in which the opening frame, supporting evidence, and closing all reinforce the same role-specific case."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"Assesses the professionalism and mechanical accuracy of the prose, including spelling, grammar, and ease of reading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, usage, or grammar errors that noticeably distract, undermine credibility, or suggest weak attention to detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several visible mechanical errors or awkward constructions, but the overall message remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally clear and professional with only minor errors or rough spots."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is polished, easy to read, and professionally phrased with very few mechanical issues."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally clean and polished, with precise wording, smooth flow, and no noticeable mechanical distractions."}]}]}
